"''Get eyes on it.|An Imperial pilot and Novitz|audio=Novitz-Activity-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} '''Novitz''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]]. During or after [[18 BBY]], the lieutenant [[Commanding officer|commanded]] a [[Imperial research transport|science vessel]] docked at [[Imperial Station 003]] that was scheduled to travel to the secret [[Tantiss Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Wayland]]. After the [[Starship|vessel]] launched from the [[Space station|station]], he received reports of unscheduled [[droid]] activity in the cargo hold and sent a [[TK stormtrooper]] to investigate. The stowaway [[Cloning|clone]] [[Echo]] then [[stun]]ned the [[stormtrooper]] and fooled Novitz into believing that the activity had been a malfunction by impersonating the [[trooper]] over [[Comlink|comms]]. The lieutenant then gave the order to jump to [[hyperspace]], unaware that Echo had turned off the vessel's [[proximity sensor]]s and allowed his comrades in [[Clone Force 99]] to attach a [[Alpha-44|shuttle]] to Novitz's vessel. Upon reaching Wayland, the shuttle detached from Novitz's science vessel before it landed at Tantiss. Novitz and his crew then had their clearances checked at the base, but Echo managed to infiltrate the base undetected. Clone Force 99 ultimately [[Skirmish on Wayland|rescued]] the [[prisoner]]s being held in Tantiss Base, and the facility was shuttered indefinitely. ==Biography== ===Preparation at Imperial Station 003=== {{Quote|A science vessel docked in Bay 8 is set to depart for Tantiss, and soon.''"
"''Let's get to that navicomputer and pull the coordinates.''"
"''We can't. The vessel is tagged for direct uplink after it launches.|Echo and Hunter discuss Novitz's vessel|audio=Echo-Hunter-ScienceVessel-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} [[File:NovitzStormtroopers-TBB-IntoTheBreach.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Datapad in hand, Novitz stands before a group of TK troopers in an Imperial hangar and gestures at them. A white-armored Imperial Commando stands beside him.|Novitz's science vessel docked at Imperial Station 003.]] Novitz was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|officer corps]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]. During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|S3}} he held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and [[Commanding officer|commanded]] an [[Imperial research transport]] docked in [[Bay 8 (Imperial Station 003)|Bay 8]] of [[Imperial Station 003]] in [[orbit]] above the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Coruscant]]. Shortly before the [[Starship|vessel]] was set to depart for [[Tantiss Base]], a secret Imperial facility located in [[Mount Tantiss]] on the planet [[Wayland]],{{Databank|mount-tantiss|Mount Tantiss}} Novitz stood on the vessel's [[Turbolift|cargo lift]] in Bay 8 and scanned{{TBB|Into the Breach}} {{AD|Disney+}} a row of [[TK stormtrooper]]s one by one as they boarded the science vessel. Novitz then boarded the vessel and entered the [[cockpit]], ordering the crew to initiate the launch sequence and receiving an affirmative from the [[Unidentified TK stormtrooper pilot|pilot]]. After the ship had launched from the [[Space station|station]], it received the coordinates for Tantiss via a direct uplink. The [[pilot]] then reported to Novitz that there was unscheduled [[droid]] activity in the vessel's cargo hold. This was, in fact, the rogue [[Cloning|clone]] [[Echo]], who had stowed away on board the ship to turn off its [[proximity sensor]]s and allow his comrades in [[Clone Force 99]] to attach the [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] [[Alpha-44]] to the science vessel so that it would take them to Tantiss. ===Infiltrator delivery=== {{Quote|Step aside. This cargo must be offloaded at once.''"
"''We're here to search this vessel and check everyone's clearance.''"
"''That was already completed at the orbital station.''"
"''Hemlock's orders.''"
"''Fine.|Novitz and Scorch|audio=Novitz-Scorch-TBB-FlashStrike.flac|{{TBB|Flash Strike}}}} [[File:NovitzBridge-TBB-IntoTheBreach.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Novtiz stands on the bridge of his science vessel, three TK troopers seated at consoles in front of him and two Imperial Commandos stood in the shadows behind him.|Novitz commanded an Imperial science vessel.]] Novitz gave orders for the cargo hold to be investigated, and a TK [[stormtrooper]] entered alone before being [[stun]]ned by Echo. Not having [[time]] for further delays, the lieutenant then contacted the [[trooper]] over [[Comlink|comms]] for an update. Echo retrieved the stunned trooper's comlink and responded to Novitz, impersonating the trooper and giving the all clear, claiming the activity must have been a malfunction. Satisfied, Novitz gave the order for the science vessel to jump to [[hyperspace]]. Echo then turned off the sensors, giving the clone [[Hunter]] just enough time to attach Alpha-44 to Novitz's vessel before it left the [[Coruscant system]]. Once the science vessel reached Wayland's [[atmosphere]], Alpha-44 detached, leaving Novitz's shuttle to reach Tantiss with Echo still on board. Upon landing at the base, the lieutenant and his crew were lowered into a hangar on the vessel's cargo lift with the ship's cargo. On the floor, they were greeted by a group of the base's TK troopers led by [[clone commando]] [[Scorch]], who blocked their path. When Novitz ordered Scorch's men out of the way, the [[commando]] refused, explaining that they were to search the vessel and check the clearance of Novitz and the rest of the crew. [[File:NovitzScorch-TBB-FlashStrike.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=The Imperial Commando Scorch, with eight TK troopers stood at attention behind him, stands in front of Novitz as the lieutenant looks down from the cargo lift of his science vessel. Behind Novitz two more TK troopers push carts of cargo from the vessel.|Novitz submitted to inspection upon reaching Tantiss Base.]] The lieutenant objected, saying that the checks had been performed at Imperial Station 003, but relented upon learning that Scorch's orders came from [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]], who led Tantiss Base and had learned that Clone Force 99 had infiltrated the orbital station. Novitz and his men then presented themselves for inspection, but Echo was not among them and managed to slip off the science vessel in disguise and infiltrate the base. ===An end to Tantiss=== {{Quote|Doctor, there is an incoming transmission from Governor Tarkin.|Novitz|audio=Novitz-Tarkin-TBB-TheCavalryHasArrived.flac|{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}}}} [[File:NovitzTrainingRoom-TBB-TheCavalryHasArrived.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Hemlock, Scorch, and Novtiz stand talking among the pods on Wayland in which the Bad Batch are being tortured.|Novitz reported a transmission from Governor Tarkin to Hemlock shortly before the doctor's death.]] After Clone Force 99's [[Gender|sister]], [[Omega]], who was being held captive inside Tantiss Base, [[Skirmish on Wayland|set loose]] a [[Zillo Beast]] that caused destruction throughout the facility, the rogue clones were captured trying to infiltrate the base. As Hemlock oversaw their [[torture]] in the base's training room, Novitz approached and informed the doctor that he had an incoming transmission from Imperial [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], who had learned of the Zillo Beast's escape. Hemlock took the call but was [[Death|killed]] soon after, along with a number of other personnel at the base, while Clone Force 99 escaped with Omega and the other [[prisoner]]s being held there. Tarkin arrived soon after their escape and chose to shutter the Tantiss facility indefinitely. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Report. We don't have time for more delays.''"
"''All clear. It must have been a malfunction, sir.|Novitz is fooled by Echo's impersonation of a stormtrooper|audio=Novitz-Report-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} Novitz was successfully fooled by Echo's impersonation of a stormtrooper over comms. He had light skin, [[Color|blond]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Initiate launch sequence.''"
"''Yes, sir.|Novitz and the pilot of the science vessel|audio=Novitz-Initiate-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} Novitz wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with two [[officer's disk]]s, one on the buckle of a black [[belt]] and the other on a gray [[Imperial kepi]]. He used a [[datapad]] while commanding the science vessel and had a [[rank insignia plaque]] that showed two blue pips and one red. ==Behind the scenes== Novitz was voiced by [[Jeff Boehm]] in "[[Into the Breach]]," the thirteenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[April 17]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} Although the character's name was listed in the episode's credits, it was unclear which Imperial lieutenant in the episode the name applied to until a [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry for{{Databank|lt-holmes|Lt. Holmes}} the only other lieutenant, [[Holmes]], was released the [[April 18|following day]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Novitz|imagecat=Images of Novitz}} *{{TBB|Into the Breach}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Flash Strike}} *{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Novitz |ja=ノヴィッツ |ka=ნოვიცი |nl=Novitz }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
